title: Open compact support is t-exact through all coefficient stages
statement:
Fix a finite field $k_0$ of characteristic $p$, its algebraic closure $k$, a prime $\ell\ne p$, an algebraic closure $\Qlb$ of $\mathbf Q_\ell$, and a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ inside $\Qlb$, with valuation ring $\mathcal O_E$, uniformizer $\varpi_E$, and $A_{E,n}=\mathcal O_E/\varpi_E^n$. Let $j:U\hookrightarrow X$ be an open immersion of separated finite-type $k$-schemes [def-weil-open-immersion, def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties]. Use the derived-complete integral constructible category and its rational and common-stage versions [def-weil-derived-complete-integral-detailed, def-weil-algebraically-closed-coefficients], standard pairs [def-weil-constructible-standard-tstructure], and constructible hearts [def-weil-constructible-heart]. Let $J_\Lambda=Rj_{!,\Lambda}$ be the actual compact-support operation of [def-weil-integral-rational-qbar-compact-support], using the compactification $(j,\operatorname{id}_X)$, and its specified scalar comparisons [def-weil-compact-support-coefficient-action].

The scheme $X$ is Noetherian and $j$ is quasi-compact. For $K\in D^b_c(U,\mathcal O_E)$ the actual integral operation
$$J_{\mathcal O_E}K=R\varprojlim_n\operatorname{Res}_n j_!(K\otimes^L_{\mathcal O_E}A_{E,n})$$
has a canonical natural isomorphism to termwise localized ringed-site extension by zero $j_!K$. This identifies the realized open adjunction unit and counit with the ringed-site unit and counit. The latter extension is exact on module sheaves; its output on $K$ is derived complete and constructible. In particular, for every integer $a$, the canonical comparison is
$$\mathcal H^a(J_{\mathcal O_E}K)\simeq j_!\mathcal H^a(K),$$
and $J_{\mathcal O_E}$ preserves each cohomological vanishing half-line. This assertion concerns the actual complete integral objects, without requiring cohomology to commute with reduction modulo $\varpi_E^n$.

For $\Lambda=E$ and $\Lambda=\Qlb$, $J_\Lambda$ preserves both standard halves, restricts to an exact functor of constructible hearts, and has the natural canonical comparison
$$\mathcal H^a(J_\Lambda L)\xrightarrow{\sim}J_\Lambda\mathcal H^a(L).$$
The integral identification, its open unit, and the cohomology comparisons are compatible with the specified finite-field scalar comparisons, rationalization, and the common-stage representatives. In particular the open tensor comparisons, including completed scalar extension through the defining derived limit, give the same maps after enlarging $E$; the common-stage comparisons are independent of the chosen finite field and arrow representatives.

proof.text: Apply lem-sf-open-roos-extension-comparison to j: U and X are Noetherian and qcqs and j is quasi-compact. Apply lem-kun-dimension-finite-type separately to U and X to get finite dimension. Their local rings are k-algebras, so ell is invertible. The category here is the intrinsic category of def-weil-derived-complete-integral-detailed. For that very category, lem-sf-intrinsic-integral-standard-truncations gives ambient boundedness and closure under both ambient truncations, without assuming compatible etale-origin witnesses. It is a full triangulated subcategory by lem-weil-integral-constructible-triangulated. Ambient orthogonality restricts to this full subcategory, its truncation triangles stay inside, and its objects are bounded; thus its standard pair is a bounded t-structure with the ambient truncations and maps. At rational and common stages prop-constructible-truncations supplies the bounded standard t-structures and finite-stage truncation maps. By def-weil-constructible-standard-tstructure the rational halves are the isomorphism closures of integral halves; hence raw localization is t-exact directly from these definitions. These are the categories and pairs required below, for every finite enlargement of E.

proof.text:
Write R for the completed integral coefficient sheaf and let Rcal and Lcal denote reduction and total derived limit. For the chosen compactification (j,id_X), the proper-image factor is the identity. Thus the actual functor in def-weil-integral-rational-qbar-compact-support is Lcal_X J_j Rcal_U, with precisely the strict quotient transitions specified there. Apply lem-sf-integral-open-reduction-comparison to the complete K. It gives a whole-system isomorphism r_j(K):Rcal_X(j_!K) ≅ J_j Rcal_U K, invertibility of the actual unit u_{j_!K}, and the natural comparison
 d_K = u_{j_!K}^{-1} Lcal_X(r_j(K))^{-1}: J_{O_E}K ≅ j_!K.
Its evaluations are the canonical open tensor maps, with all quotient transitions retained. The same cited statement identifies the realized unit and counit with the localized ringed-site unit and counit. In particular this identifies the actual functor and adjunction, rather than choosing an isomorphic object separately for each K.

proof.text: The same integral comparison states that j_!K is derived complete. For constructibility apply lem-sf-integral-compact-support-constructible with f=j and c=(j,id_X): j is separated and of finite type, its source and target are finite type over k, and ell is invertible. The strict tower in that lemma is exactly the tower of Step 2, so J_{O_E}K belongs to D^b_c(X,O_E), and its isomorphism d_K puts j_!K in that full subcategory as well. This obtains both finite-level constructibility and one uniform reduction interval; it imposes no finite-Tor condition over A_{E,n}. Finally, lem-pur-site-restriction-module-adjunction-exact applied to the completed ringed slice says that the underlying module-sheaf extension by zero is exact.

proof.text:
Represent K by a cochain complex C of completed-ring modules. By lem-sp-exact-functor-preserves-homology(c), exact j_! identifies the cycles, boundaries and quotient in degree a, naturally in C:
 H^a(j_!C) = ker(j_!d^a)/im(j_!d^{a-1}) ≅ j_!(ker d^a/im d^{a-1}) = j_!H^a(C).
Consequently it preserves quasi-isomorphisms. Its termwise action is additive, commutes with shifts and with the signed mapping-cone formula, and hence induces an exact triangulated integral functor with its usual shift comparison. Compose the displayed cohomology isomorphism with H^a(d_K). This gives the claimed canonical H^a(J_{O_E}K) ≅ j_!H^a(K) and preserves either vanishing half-line, for any a. These are ambient cohomology sheaves of complete objects. No assertion that H^a(K tensor^L A_{E,n}) equals a reduction of H^a(K) enters the argument.

source.place: Tag 010N, lemma-exact-functor; exact functors preserve kernels, images and homology

proof.text:
For E contained in L write T for the actual completed scalar extension. By lem-pod-completed-scalar-extension-texact, T is the derived functor of exact ordinary coefficient extension, equals its defining strict-limit construction, and preserves both integral halves. The arbitrary-ring open tensor comparison of lem-sf-open-tensor-normalization gives gamma:T_X j_{E!} ≅ j_{L!} T_U. This comparison includes the open unit: after restriction it is the identity. Its compatibility with the actual completed construction is also explicit: at quotient m its generator map is [x] tensor b ↦ [x tensor b|_U]; quotient maps send b to its image, so these maps form one strict tower map. Apply the augmentation-normalized lambda of lem-sf-open-roos-extension-comparison over O_L to pass through the defining derived limit of def-weil-integral-scalar-extension. It preserves the scalar-unit augmentation, so the resulting gamma is the completed open tensor comparison with the same unit. Under d_E and d_L the compact-support scalar map is
 b_{L/E}=d_L^{-1} gamma T_X(d_E).
This is the prescribed map of def-weil-compact-support-coefficient-action: its mixed unit has exactly s tensor x ↦ iota_m(s) tensor (1 tensor x), followed by the same limit map. The coherence assertion of lem-fix-operation-reduction ensures these comparisons preserve tensor associators, units and counits, and successive scalar extensions, as actual derived maps. This uses a simultaneous strict construction, not faithfulness of separate reduction functors.

proof.text: Apply lem-a1-texact-coefficient-stage-descent to the integral functors of Step 4 for all finite E. They are O_E-linear because termwise j_! and d_E preserve scalar multiplication. The integral and rational bounded t-structures, the t-exact localization and the finite-stage truncations were checked in Step 1. The exact t-exact scalar transitions are given by lem-pod-completed-scalar-extension-texact, rationalized; the compatible beta maps are the b maps of Step 5, rationalized. The raw localization and pair categories are exactly def-weil-rationalization-karoubi and def-weil-algebraically-closed-coefficients. In particular triangles are images of integral triangles up to isomorphism, or represented over one finite field, as required by the descent lemma. Its descended functors are the actual J_E and J_Qlb of def-weil-integral-rational-qbar-compact-support, since that definition uses the same integral values and scalar action. The descent lemma now gives preservation of both standard halves, exact functors of hearts, and canonical natural cohomology comparisons. Invert its F H^a ≅ H^a F comparison to obtain the direction H^a(J_Lambda L) ≅ J_Lambda H^a(L) requested here.

source.place: Proposition 6.8.14 and Remark 6.8.15; formal coefficient descent as in the cited abstract lemma

proof.text: The integral comparison of Step 4 is the canonical truncation comparison: its kernel and quotient maps are exactly the cycle inclusion and homology projection. Uniqueness in lem-pod-texact-truncation-comparison therefore identifies it with the cohomology comparison used in Step 6 after localization. That lemma also says its truncation comparisons commute with natural transformations and composition. Apply this to d_E, to t-exact rationalization, and to b_{L/E} between the two composites of t-exact functors of Step 5, then shift by a. It follows that the integral, rational and common-stage cohomology maps commute with the specified scalar comparisons. The open unit already matches the ringed-site unit by Step 2, and its scalar normalization was checked in Step 5. Finally lem-a1-texact-coefficient-stage-descent states that the common-stage comparisons are represented by these finite-stage comparisons independently of further enlargement. For arbitrary presentations of the same common-stage object use lem-weil-compact-support-finite-field-independence: the comparison is relative to the specified representing isomorphisms and independent of the common overfield and arrow representatives. Thus replacing a common-stage arrow by an equal representative gives the same cohomology comparison and the same normalized open maps.
